goal: Implement BIP 54 Consensus Cleanup validation rules on regtest without activating on mainnet
Allows testing fixes for legacy sigops DoS, timewarp attacks, and Merkle tree collision vulnerabilities
agreement: Broad concept approval without detailed stated reasons (dergoegge, fanquake, theStack, stickies-v)
Resolved concern about miner enforcement of the Murch-Zawy rule (fjahr)
Resolved concern about lax mempool behavior across the activation boundary (ariard)
Resolved concern about error categorization before activation (polespinasa)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it addresses consensus hazards like legacy sigops DoS, timewarp attacks, and Merkle collisions
Enables multi-node testing across validation infrastructure prior to any mainnet deployment
